challenges.name: Lyra's Vault
challenges.description: Lyra is locked in the vault's central chest-cage. The seal is ancient but yields to a firm hand. "You came all this way... let's go home."
challenges.successText: The runes yield with a deep hum — the seal cracks open and Lyra steps free at last.
challenges.failText: The ancient seal flares and snaps shut — the runes resist. Steady your mind and try again.
